title: Unit 36 Consolidation: Synthesis — Your Own Voice
goal: Bring together C1 precision, self-editing, mood and word order, irony and concession, and spoken register versatility.

items: I can write dense, precise formal prose with compound infinitives and el cual / lo cual.
I can edit my own drafts for dequeísmo, normative gerunds and collective agreement.
I can use double-mood verbs, clitic dislocation, concession and irony to convey exact stance.
I can shift naturally between formal prose and conversational Spanish in my own voice.
